# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c33 P30](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril is an extraordinarily handsome young man with dark, dreamy, and expressive eyes, and a charming smile. He dresses stylishly and possesses an attractive, polite demeanor, though he is considered somewhat lacking in physical substance by a few.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010), [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c33 P8](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0008), [v3 c33 P28](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Cyril is a romantic, polite, and attentive young man with a refined artistic sensibility. He is deeply sentimental, expressively poetic, and constant in his courteous manners toward others. However, he is prone to intense romantic infatuations, lacks a sense of humor, and can act dramatically when rejected.

_Sources: [v3 c21 P16](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0016), [v3 c26 P21](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0021), [v3 c28 P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), [v3 c33 P30](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0030), [v3 c38 P20](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0020)_

## Traits

- romantic  <sub>[v3 c38 P28](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0028)</sub>
- polite  <sub>[v3 c33 P28](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0028)</sub>
- lacks a sense of humor  <sub>[v3 c21 P21](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0021)</sub>
- prone to romantic infatuation  <sub>[v3 c34 P21](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0021)</sub>

## Abilities

- writing poetry and sonnets  <sub>[v3 c26 P21](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0021)</sub>

## Goals

- to marry the girl he falls in love with  <sub>[v3 c33 P28](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0028), [v3 c38 P21](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0021)</sub>
- to complete his Arts degree at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)</sub>

## History

Cyril attended Wexcombe College, pausing his studies after his Freshman year to travel through Europe with his ailing mother. Upon returning to Wexcombe, he met Nell Harcourt in the park during a autumn rainstorm and escorted her home, quickly falling deeply in love with her. Throughout his Junior and Senior years at college, he pursued Nell attentively, sending her flowers and writing sonnets dedicated to her. During their Senior year, Cyril invited Nell to meet his family and eventually proposed to her at a pavilion overlooking the harbor. To his surprise and heartbreak, Nell rejected his proposal because she did not love him as he loved her. Following her rejection, he eventually recovered and married a sweet young woman with whom he found complete happiness.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P46](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0046), [v3 c26 P21](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0021), [v3 c33 P16](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0016), [v3 c33 P23](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0023), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- He paused his college studies for two years to travel in Europe with his mother when her health broke down  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P46](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0046)</sub>
- His father passed away prior to his college years  <sub>[v3 c25 P46](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0046)</sub>
- He belongs to one of the wealthy, elite 'Bluenose' families of Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P46](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0046)</sub>

## Quotes

> Excuse me—could I provide you cover with my umbrella?  <sub>[v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028)</sub>

> I have not ever encountered anyone quite like you, Nell. You are a constant surprise to me.  <sub>[v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042)</sub>

> No other female will ever have my affection. I am grateful to you for your companionship, if nothing else. Farewell, Nell.  <sub>[v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)</sub>
